youtube.title: PDF to Animated Book With AI (Claude Code Skill)
youtube.description:
Papermorph is a free, open-source Claude Code skill that turns a PDF into an animated book you can read online: it plans the book, storyboards it, writes narration, then adds animation and quizzes. Its live bookshelf already has a 68-chapter Elementary Algebra book.
The catch: today it runs on Opus 5.5 only (not free), with no image models, multilingual support or background music yet.
Repo: github.com/DozenTwelve/Papermorph (MIT). Bookshelf: papermorph.diamonddoge.org. Demo footage from the repo.
